jamie (eng-runtime): Heads-up: vuln triage flagged a libcrypto regression in our base image. proposing a fast rebuild + signed release. low exploitability but we should be proactive.

sofia (eng-security): Can you share which packages and which CVEs? need to check attestations and backport diffs before we sign.

jamie (eng-runtime): CVE-2026-1984 and CVE-2026-1985. patched in our distro mirror. build artifacts ready but unsigned.

omar (eng-infra): We need a KMS key for signing. Suggest creating a temporary customer-managed alias under our account: alias/rebuild-3899-temp. Will require kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey for the infra-builds role.

sofia (eng-security): Also request: (1) CI pipeline must emit SBOM and cosign attestations (2) audit trail retained for 13 months (3) RBAC to limit who can trigger promotions.

rita (oncall): Proposed rollout: push to staging-canary (5%) -> monitor 2h -> 25% -> 100% in 24h if no regressions. Who owns rollback?

jamie (eng-runtime): I'll own rollout/metrics. rollback plan: flip router weights back to previous image, remove canary tags, redeploy old replica set. we should keep both images signed for forensic trace.

sofia (eng-security): Need SIEM inbound for cosign attestations. Can we ship attestations to S3 + CloudTrail events?

omar (eng-infra): Yes. I'll enable CloudTrail data events for ECR and S3 and forward to our SIEM collector. Will also attach an IAM policy to infra-builds role. Example CLI:

```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name infra-builds --policy-name RebuildCosignPolicy --policy-document '{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{\n    "Effect":"Allow",\n    "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey"],\n    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_TEMP_KEY"\n  }]\n}'
```

sofia (eng-security): We'll need a short-lived exception in the signing ACLs so only infra-builds and a small list of SRE identities can sign. Add an approval step in the pipeline with two approvers.

jamie (eng-runtime): CI changes: add `cosign sign` step, `cosign attest --predicate sbom.json`, and upload sbom.json to artifacts. Example snippet in pipeline YAML (high level):

```
- run: cosign sign --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3899-temp image:base-v3
- run: cosign attest --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3899-temp --predicate sbom.json image:base-v3
- run: aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://redwood-attestations/base-v3/3899998888/
```

omar (eng-infra): I'll provision the key and attach policy. ETA ~30m. Also will create a RoleBinding so the build-controller SA can read attestations in the `attest` namespace:

```
kubectl create rolebinding build-controller-attest-reader -n attest --role=attest-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
```

sofia (eng-security): Confirm retention: SIEM retention is 90d today. We need 13 months for signing metadata. Omar -> open ticket to extend retention for this event and configure S3 lifecycle to keep attestations 13+ months.

rita (oncall): Launch window? I can coordinate pager coverage for the canary. If we see an uptick in OOMs or startup failures, we stop and invoke postmortem.

jamie (eng-runtime): Will start canary once key is ready. Will post metric links (p90 latency, image pull errors, crashloop rate). CI bot, mark build artifacts as pushed when done.

ci-bot: artifact push complete: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-v3/3899998888 — unsigned.

omar (eng-infra): Key created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_TEMP_KEY. Applied IAM policy and rolebinding.

sofia (eng-security): Great. One more: include git SHA and changelog in attestation predicates. We need provenance for audits.

jamie (eng-runtime): Will add metadata to attestations. Starting canary now (5%). Will update thread with metrics in ~15m. Please keep approvals in CI ready.

rita (oncall): Copy. I'll stand by and escalate if anything pops.
